claims_reviewed.claim: A Network Finance-branded PNet advert for Financial Controller (Contract) (ID 4272034; ref NFR011208-LEA-1) was retrievable in the Western Cape profile 51189 snapshot.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct PNet detail page displays the title/reference and Network Finance advertiser; profile page reports the 74-result Western Cape snapshot. Network Finance is the advertiser, not the verified hiring employer.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold as an agency advert only; do not assert an employer identity.

claims_reviewed.claim: The raw role title, location and core functional scope are as transcribed.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct page describes a six-month operational Financial Controller contract in Thornton, with cashbook, international payments, FX, cash flow, VAT/PAYE, reconciliations, audit, Sage 300/Accpac and import/export duties.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold direct-page wording only; preserve the taxonomy boundary note.

claims_reviewed.claim: The R420,000 p.a. economic salary screen is cleared by Approx. R50,000 per month (approx. R600,000 annualized run rate; flexible; not a guaranteed minimum).
claims_reviewed.evidence: The body states “market-related remuneration – benchmark approximately R50,000 per month, flexible for the right candidate.” Multiplication by 12 gives an approximate R600,000 annualized run rate, above the R420,000 p.a. screen; the rate is not guaranteed and the six-month contract total would be approximately R300,000 at that benchmark.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the displayed pay evidence for screening only; do not infer package composition or employer acceptance.

claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct advert names Network Finance as the advertiser and uses an anonymous client/sector description; no end-employer name is displayed.
claims_reviewed.decision: Reject any employer-name inference; keep employer and agreed-client status unknown.

claims_reviewed.claim: The employer-side vacancy is confirmed to remain open.
claims_reviewed.evidence: PNet direct detail page was retrievable and displayed a relative age of 1 week ago at retrieval; no employer confirmation or closing date was shown.
claims_reviewed.decision: Downgrade to listed on PNet at retrieval; employer-side acceptance remains unknown.

claims_reviewed.claim: This is a Boschendal or Laurium agreed-client opportunity.
claims_reviewed.evidence: No end-employer name or agreed-client relationship appears in the direct listing.
claims_reviewed.decision: Do not promote to agreed-client priority.

claims_reviewed.claim: The noted similar/related advert is the same requisition.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Possible duplicate/repost with 4271281: both are 6-month Financial Controller ads in Cape Town's Northern Suburbs with near-identical international/product-focused accounting, cashbook, foreign-currency, import/export and Sage 300 scope. Recruiter, reference and pay expression differ; do not merge as confirmed.
claims_reviewed.decision: Retain all source IDs separately and count once provisionally only for aggregate triage where the description indicates likely overlap; obtain recruiter/employer confirmation before merging.

claims_upheld: A retrievable Network Finance PNet agency advert for Financial Controller (Contract) was observed on 2026-10-07.
The direct page's displayed role, location, relative age and remuneration are preserved without inferring an end employer.
The salary screen uses direct pay evidence only; any annualization or uncertainty is explicitly disclosed.
claims_downgraded: PNet visibility and a recent relative listing age do not prove the end employer still accepts applications.
Network Finance is the agency advertiser, not a confirmed hiring-company identity.
No Boschendal or Laurium relationship is established.
claims_removed: No employer, candidate, hiring owner, direct employer email or personal contact detail is inferred from anonymous sector/location language.
contradictions: Direct page header/metadata says Permanent / Full Time, while the advert body says a six-month contract.

The monthly amount is an approximate, flexible benchmark and not a guaranteed lower bound; the annualized run-rate calculation is provisional. A six-month total at the approximate benchmark would be about R300,000.
unknowns: End-employer identity and employer-side vacancy acceptance are unresolved.
The role is not evidenced as a Boschendal or Laurium agreed-client opportunity.
Package composition (base, CTC, bonus or variable pay) is unstated unless expressly noted above.
No employer stakeholder, company email pattern, target-company map or candidate map is activated while the employer remains unknown.
Potential duplicate/repost status requires recruiter or employer confirmation; keep source IDs distinct until resolved.
Contract duration and annual salary basis must be confirmed; six-month total value is not the same as annualized salary.
The approximate R50,000/month benchmark is flexible, not a guaranteed minimum; the salary gate is included only as a provisional annualized-rate screen.
next_research_actions: Confirm whether the two contract-controller references are the same requisition, resolve the body-versus-metadata contract conflict and approximate salary floor, identify the end employer, and verify current acceptance.
Do not begin stakeholder/company-email, target-company or candidate mapping until the hiring employer is confirmed or high-confidence.
